items.gap: Deployment identity and MFA evidence not yet bound to a target government environment.
items.closureEvidence: Target-environment IAM architecture, MFA enforcement evidence, privileged-role inventory, access review records.

items.gap: FIPS 140-3 validation cannot be established from repository code.
items.closureEvidence: CMVP certificate or inherited validated service, runtime provider configuration, key-management evidence.

items.gap: FedRAMP authorization cannot be established from repository code.
items.closureEvidence: Applicable FedRAMP path, SSP/SAP/SAR/POA&M evidence, continuous monitoring package, accepted authorization evidence.

items.gap: CJIS acceptance cannot be established unless CJI is in scope and the applicable CSA requirements are satisfied.
items.closureEvidence: CJI scope declaration, CSA requirements, personnel/access evidence, audit evidence, applicable agreements.

items.gap: CUI readiness cannot be established unless CUI is in scope and SP 800-171 Rev. 3 requirements are assessed against the deployment boundary.
items.closureEvidence: CUI boundary, requirement assessment, SSP, remediation evidence, contractual flow-down requirements.

items.gap: Virginia AI deployment requires use-case registration and approval evidence when Commonwealth scope triggers it.
items.closureEvidence: AI inventory, Archer/Planview records when applicable, human oversight and model-risk evidence.

items.gap: Physical, personnel, media, continuity-test, and production monitoring controls require deployment evidence.
items.closureEvidence: Facility/cloud inheritance records, personnel controls, media handling, exercise results, monitoring/SLA evidence.

items.gap: Independent assessment evidence is not present.
items.closureEvidence: Assessment plan/results from the assessor or authority required by the selected deployment path.
